title: PR #56: audit: establish evidence-first G1-G9 ecosystem audit baseline
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Purpose

Operationalize the agreed ecosystem audit path without converting architecture claims into readiness claims.

## Implemented

- G1 Repository Reality audit contract
- G2 Core Dependency Chain: atc-algorithm → a-townchain → atc-node → atc-vm → atc-storage → atc-indexer
- G3-G9 gate registry
- evidence-first / fail-closed status vocabulary
- machine-readable readiness matrix
- explicit requirement for source, test, CI and E2E evidence
- explicit prohibition on treating umbrella/subtree presence as integration proof

## Important

This PR does not mark any unverified component or edge as integrated or production-ready. Initial G2 entries remain UNKNOWN until concrete evidence is collected.

Next operational step: perform the real G1/G2 source + CI audit and populate the matrix with exact repository HEADs, symbols, tests, workflow runs and E2E evidence.
